footer.about: A place made for our family.
footer.aboutText: This site is for making planning our stays in Nessebar easier. Two apartments, several family members and plenty of dates meant one thing - we needed everything in one place.
footer.label: Family reservation system

apartments.intro: Two apartments side by side, one shared balcony and room for time together.
apartments.locationText: Apartments 15B and 16B sit side by side in the Odysey complex. Both have a view of the large central pool and are connected by a shared balcony.

balcony.heading: One balcony, two apartments
balcony.text: Apartments 15B and 16B are connected by a shared balcony overlooking the pool. A good spot for morning coffee, an evening chat or planning the next day.

booking.heading: Who's coming, and when?
booking.intro: A reservation calendar helps us keep track of who's in Nessebar and which apartment they're using.
booking.text: Just create a reservation and everyone has an up-to-date view of both apartments.
booking.feature1Text: At a glance, we see which apartment is occupied and which is free.
booking.feature2Text: Dates, apartment and number of people. Everything you need in one place.
booking.feature3Text: Every family member has access to the information they need.

roles.heading: Everyone has their own access
roles.text: Different family members need different options. That's why the app has several access levels — from managing the whole system to a simple overview of reservations.
roles.readonlyText: Views reservations and information without making changes.

beaches.heading: Beaches
beaches.intro: The sea is practically around the corner. Pick one to suit your mood.

trips.heading: Trips
trips.intro: When you want to venture further, there are plenty of spots nearby for a day trip.
